stack.title: Compose stack
stack.description: {{count}} services deployed from one compose file, reconciled one by one in dependency order.
stack.loadFailed: Could not load the stack status: {{message}}

rollback.title: Roll back the stack
rollback.description: Re-applies an earlier compose file through the normal deploy path and records it as a new revision. Generated passwords stay the same, so data in volumes keeps working.
rollback.none: There is no earlier revision to roll back to yet.

down.title: Tear down {{app}}
down.description: Removes every service and its containers. Named volumes are kept unless you also remove them, so a later deploy under the same name finds its data again.
down.removeVolumes: Also delete the stack's volumes (the data is gone for good)

preview.title: What will deploy
preview.profilesAvailable: Profiles in this file: {{profiles}}. Pass them on the CLI with --profile-name to include those services.
preview.needsRoot: This file bind-mounts host directories, which needs the root ability.
preview.build: build from source (not supported here, use a git deploy)

install.title: Install
install.description: Fill in the settings this template asks for. Generated values are created once, stored encrypted, and reused on every redeploy.
install.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to pick one for you
install.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Prefixes every container and volume of this stack.
install.domainHint: Optional. Point its DNS at this server and HTTPS is set up for you.

publishedPortError.published_port_invalid: Use HOST:CONTAINER with an optional /udp, for example 51820:51820/udp. Each host port and protocol can appear once.
publishedPortError.published_port_conflict: Another service already publishes that host port and protocol. Pick a free host port, or stop the other service.
publishedPortError.published_port_remote_node: Host ports can only be published on the control plane's own node. Move the service to this node or drop the host port.
publishedPortError.published_port_in_use: Another process on this server already uses that port: pick another host port or stop that process. A private 127.0.0.1 bind is not blocked by system resolvers.

bundleImport.title: Import an app bundle
bundleImport.description: Upload a tar written by apps export on another instance. Secret values are never in a bundle; services are saved stopped.
bundleImport.name: App name
bundleImport.namePlaceholder: App name (optional, defaults to the bundle)
bundleImport.done: Imported {{app}}. Set its secrets, then start it.

source.title: Deploy from git
source.intro: Connect this stack to a repository. Each push (or release) redeploys the compose file from that branch.
source.secretOnce: Copy the webhook secret now. It is shown only once and is not stored in this browser.
source.secretHint: Paste it as the secret of a push webhook on your git host.
source.deployStarted: Deploy finished from the branch head

pathErrors.control: The path contains a control or invisible character.
pathErrors.absolute: Use a path relative to the repository root, without a leading slash.
pathErrors.parent: The path must stay inside the repository (no ..).
pathErrors.notFile: Name a compose file, not a folder.
pathErrors.extension: The compose file must end in .yml or .yaml.

errors.kindConflict: This app already deploys a single service from git. Disconnect that source first, then connect the compose repository.
errors.protected: This app is in a protected environment. Push to the branch so the deploy goes through approval.
errors.frozen: Deploys are frozen for this app right now. Try again once the freeze ends.
errors.pollNotAllowed: A compose stack deploys on push or release only, polling is not available.
errors.notDeployed: Deploy the stack once, then connect its repository.
errors.noMasterKey: Git connections need a master key on this control plane.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Commands that run on a cron schedule inside one service's container.
schedules.empty: No schedules yet. Add one with levelrail-cli compose schedules add {{app}} <service> --schedule CRON -- CMD.
